title: Rotate payment API keys after exposure
description: A live key was pasted into a debugging ticket. Rotate immediately and remove it from the history. The exposed key was sk_live_FAKEDEMO0002.

comments.author: Tom Becker
comments.body: Rotated the key and redeployed. Questions to tom.becker@shopfront.example. Temporary admin password was password=Winter2025Temp! and has been changed.

comments.author: Tom Becker
comments.body: We decided to store provider keys only in the secrets manager from now on and block commits that contain strings starting with sk_live.
